English Requirements for Graduate Students
English proficiency requirements for graduate applicants
There are several ways to demonstrate your English proficiency for graduate or professional school admission. Here are the methods and minimum requirements accepted by IU Indianapolis.
Some graduate schools or programs, such as the Luddy School of Informatics, Computing, and Engineering, have stricter requirements than the minimum campus standard. Make sure to verify your program’s requirements before you apply.
Chat with an international student
Want to know more about studying at IU Indianapolis? Chat with a current international student.

English for Academic Purposes (EAP)
Some options require you to take the English for Academic Purposes (EAP) placement test before classes begin. Depending on your EAP test results, you may need to take EAP courses at the same time as your academic major courses for one or two semesters.
